description: Bolevák - úpravna vody is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Plzeň. Data from water treatment plant for Bolevák. Coverage: Statutární město Plzeň. The portal shows the English title as "Bolevák - water treatment plant" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Plzeň. Its keywords include plzeňský kraj, plzeň. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00075370/fe9f4154c8573c1c8a457ecbc0f7542b/distribuce/a7a608f5c2cb85b86971f43fdafa4395/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
